verdict.rationale: Docs confirm official availability via Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry/Azure with enterprise auth and OpenAI-compatible API, showing genuine multi-cloud distribution beyond xAI's own endpoint. However, there is no mention of AWS Bedrock support, and OpenRouter is only referenced indirectly via community usage comparisons (showing much lower usage than competitors), not as a documented first-party integration. missing for 10: Bedrock availability, explicit OpenRouter listing/partnership, independent confirmation of parity (pricing/feature parity) across these gateways.
